title: Silver Line
headline: The Foundation of Confidence
descriptionHtml:
The Foundation of Confidence

A considered first layer for everyday life. Silver Line brings clean lines and restrained detail to FANN’s vision of daily confidence.

White, Black and Navy form the initial colour direction. The collection begins with an understated expression of the FANN design language.

Concept preview. The images show a design in development. Final materials, construction, fit, colours and availability will be confirmed before release.

seo.description: A considered first layer for everyday life. Silver Line brings clean lines and restrained detail to FANN’s vision of daily confidence.

title: Gold Line
headline: Precision in Motion
descriptionHtml:
Precision in Motion

A stronger expression of the everyday essential. Gold Line combines sculpted lines, rich colour and warm accents in a design direction shaped around movement.

Six colours give this core collection its range: Maroon, Black, Ivory, Purple, Blue and Green. Names and exact shades remain provisional.

Concept preview. The images show a design in development. Final materials, construction, fit, colours and availability will be confirmed before release.

seo.description: A stronger expression of the everyday essential. Gold Line combines sculpted lines, rich colour and warm accents in a design direction shaped around movement.

title: Platinum Line
headline: The Art of Comfort
descriptionHtml:
The Art of Comfort

Quiet detail. Refined presence. Platinum Line explores the more considered side of the FANN wardrobe through subtle pattern, delicate accents and a restrained palette.

Steel Blue, Charcoal and Ivory White establish its initial colour direction. Final fabrics and finishes are still in development.

Concept preview. The images show a design in development. Final materials, construction, fit, colours and availability will be confirmed before release.

seo.description: Quiet detail. Refined presence. Platinum Line explores the more considered side of the FANN wardrobe through subtle pattern, delicate accents and a restrained palette.

title: Black Line
headline: Controlled Intensity
descriptionHtml:
Controlled Intensity

Dark tones, sculptural form and deliberate contrast. Black Line explores a bolder side of FANN through four distinct concepts: Velvet, Eclipse, Mesh and Monolith.

Each design has its own expression. Their shared intention is controlled presence, with everyday wearability still to be resolved through development.

Concept preview. The images show a design in development. Final materials, construction, fit, colours and availability will be confirmed before release.

seo.description: Dark tones, sculptural form and deliberate contrast. Black Line explores a bolder side of FANN through four distinct concepts: Velvet, Eclipse, Mesh and Monolith.

title: Legacy Line
headline: Strength, Defined Within
descriptionHtml:
Strength, Defined Within

Legacy translates qualities we choose to live by into a personal design language. Discipline. Honour. Resilience. Vision. Courage. Care.

The first six concepts draw on Spartan, Samurai, Gladiator, Pharaoh, Viking and Knight archetypes. These are interpretations of personal values, not replicas of historical clothing.

Concept preview. The images show a design in development. Final materials, construction, fit, colours and availability will be confirmed before release.

seo.description: Legacy translates qualities we choose to live by into a personal design language. Discipline. Honour. Resilience. Vision. Courage. Care.

title: Seasonal Editions
headline: A Different Expression, in Season
descriptionHtml:
A Different Expression, in Season

Occasion-led interpretations of the FANN design language. Seasonal Editions explores new colour, character and detail through the moments that shape the year.

Discover each story as the collection develops.
